decision: Advance the QK-RMSNorm-to-RoPE request-owned source candidate to the exact H200 component discriminator. Keep norm-to-dynamic-FP8 conditional on binding the production scale convention. Reject a target-head-to-acceptance persistent boundary under the current binding because the exact scorer, RNG/logit processors, acceptance predicate, and first commit consumer are absent; substituting greedy or synthetic acceptance would change the scientific question.

cpu_reference_result.timing_disposition: CPU elapsed times are descriptive implementation diagnostics and do not transfer to H200.

boundary_assessments.transfer_blocker: The admitted source trace does not bind the production activation-scale granularity or the exact linear consumer ABI.

boundary_assessments.launch_prediction: one normalization-to-RoPE producer-consumer launch boundary removed per layer if the pinned stock path is not already fused
boundary_assessments.physical_uncertainty: source-only bytes are neither measured HBM bytes nor latency; L2 residency, registers, occupancy, and stock fusion must be measured

boundary_assessments.measured: all 183 rejected fixture rows were zero-visible after commit
boundary_assessments.limit: The accepted-prefix input was synthetic; no claim is made about the real acceptance decision.

boundary_assessments.first_unavoidable_boundary: exact target distribution plus scorer/RNG/logit-processor synchronization before acceptance and KV commit
boundary_assessments.reason: The two allowed artifacts do not identify or specify this producer/consumer contract. Greedy argmax, Gumbel-max, or caller-supplied accepted lengths are excluded proxies and cannot establish exact semantics.

h200_discriminator.admission: Requires a future director-authorized zero-checkpoint H200 component session; this project did not claim a bench.

arms.name: stock
arms.input: deterministic BF16 QKV fixture generated by the same formula and positions as crossop_hotblock.rs

arms.name: candidate
arms.change: request-major fused Q/K head RMSNorm plus explicit BF16 cutpoint plus RoPE; retain provisional K/V slot ownership and feed the unchanged attention and o_proj consumers
arms.unchanged: input bytes, positions, paged metadata, K/V layout, BF16 cutpoint, attention, o_proj, stream, and output consumer

execution.smoke: In a fresh process, run one untimed local and one untimed global candidate call, synchronize each separately, persist per-arm completion, then consume output through unchanged extend_attention_fwd and o_proj.
correctness_gate: bitwise-equal post-RoPE Q/K and provisional V at the declared BF16 cutpoints
zero nonfinite values and zero rejected-slot visibility
unchanged attention/o_proj output within the pinned stock tolerance, reported as max absolute error, relative L2, and cosine error
execution.timing: Profiler off, warm caches, at least 7 alternating stock/candidate pairs per geometry, CUDA events around only the compared boundary, seeded paired 10000-resample bootstrap.
execution.path_proof: Record loaded shared-object hash, candidate symbol, launch grid/block, registers, shared memory, spills, and a completion marker after the unchanged consumer.
execution.counters: After timing, collect only DRAM bytes, L2 hit rate, registers, spills, achieved occupancy, grid waves, and launch-gap union for the compared range.

h200_discriminator.promotion_rule: Promote the boundary only if every correctness gate passes, the candidate path is proven, the paired latency interval excludes zero in the beneficial direction for both local and global geometries, and no spill/occupancy regression explains a hidden downstream loss.
negative_rules: typed source negative if pinned stock already performs the same fusion
typed semantic negative for any BF16, Q/K orientation, position, layout, provisional-slot, or consumer mismatch
typed physical negative if correctness passes but either geometry is not faster or saved source bytes do not reduce measured DRAM/critical launch-gap time
h200_discriminator.endpoint_transfer: No endpoint or 20% campaign claim follows from this component. A later matched endpoint A/B is required.
